crossRefs.note: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here?’
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…

translations.web: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
translations.bsb: then the raging waters would have swept us away.
